articles.title: Alchemy's AI-driven identity and payment service gains access to Visa network
articles.snippet: The AgentCard integration with Visa Intelligent Commerce allows AI agents built on models from any provider, including OpenAI or Anthropic, to effect commercial transactions.

articles.title: CME chief executive says company plans to sue CFTC after perpetual futures approval
articles.snippet: Kalshi's perpetual futures product did not meet the Dodd-Frank Act's definition of a "swap" and should not have been approved, Terrence Duffy said.

articles.title: G7 calls for joint action on North Korean crypto theft, cybercrime
articles.snippet: G7 leaders broadened their warning over North Korean crypto theft to include wider cybercrime as researchers link DPRK-affiliated actors to billions of dollars in stolen digital assets.

articles.title: Kentucky sues Kalshi, Polymarket, joining prediction market legal battle
articles.snippet: Kentucky has sued Polymarket, Kalshi and Kalshi’s partners Coinbase, Robinhood and Webull, over offering sports event contracts in the state.

articles.title: Crypto-backed GOP candidate wins Alabama Senate runoff with June primaries looming
articles.snippet: Several more US states are scheduled to hold primaries next week after one Republican candidate won in Alabama on Tuesday after a crypto company-backed PAC used what it called its “biggest spend of the cycle.”
